## Foods & dishes
- [[Food.com Recipes and Interactions]]: 171 tagged `finnish`. [[RecipeDB2]]: ≈140 recipes (region "Scandinavian"); not released.
- Dish inventories: [[WorldCuisines]] 19 dishes (8 Finland-only; Karelian pasty, kalakukko, Runeberg torte); [[FmLAMA]] 15 dishes (143 rows; lohikeitto, Karelian hot pot). Ingredient lists only.

## Ingredients & food composition
- No national food composition table for this country is in the vault or `Backlog/`; use [[USDA FoodData Central]] (and [[FooDB]] / [[Phenol-Explorer]] for compounds) by name matching. Fineli is not a candidate.
- Plants: [[CMAUP]] 131 plants.

## Compounds & traditional medicine
- **Human-cohort evidence:** [[Exposome-Explorer]] 570 rows (207 concentrations, 212 correlations, 140 cancer). ATBC gives 85 cancer rows (prostate, lung, colorectal), with the Finnish Mobile Clinic Surveys and KIHD.
- [[Dr. Duke's Phytochemical and Ethnobotanical Databases|Duke]] 11 records; [[KNApSAcK Family]] World lists the country (edible/medicinal species records; counts for European countries were not scraped).
- Global backbone via [[Global]]: [[FooDB]], [[Phenol-Explorer]], [[CTD]], [[SpiceRx]], [[DDID]] for food–drug interactions.

## Gaps
- No Fineli FCT and no Finnish recipe corpus.
